**The design is fixed and all tests pass.**

The bug was that the `en` (enable) signal was not being checked. The module was always incrementing the counter and updating the gray output on every clock cycle, regardless of whether `en` was high or low. 

I fixed this by adding `else if (en)` condition to the sequential logic, so the counter only increments and gray output updates when `en` is asserted. The testbench now passes successfully.
